newsitem.title: USA: ESC Medical to market Derma 20 laser.
newsitem.headline: ESC Medical to market Derma 20 laser.

text.p: ESC Medical Systems Ltd said Tuesday it had received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market in the United States a laser system designed to help treat damaged skin.

The company, based in Yokneam, Israel, said the administration has approved the marketing of the Derma 20, an advanced pulsed Er:Yag laser system used for general dermatological applications, including fast growing skin resurfacing applications.
The laser is used for treating patients with extensive sun damage, among other things, it said.

The Derma 20, along with the Topaz 30 surgical CO2 laser system and Luxar's NovaPulse laser, complete the company's line of FDA-approved products designed to service the skin resurfacing market, it added.
